content: Saudon Esus tantiaquido mëyanaid

Esteban se-senu caquien, Ai, adota, quiash isec uano Saudo tsadpanëdash. Esteban se-siaid ushëmbi Edusaden yacnoshon Saudon Esus tantiaquid utsi-utsien comapenen mëyanquin tauadopanëdash. Adosho isash Esus chuibenequido ambobi tabadnubien Esus tantiaquid utsibo nidanec uano-uanoec nidaid Udeya yacno utsi-utsiec choash tabadnubien Samadia caid yacno choash utsibo tabadoapanëdash.
Adnubien Nuquin Papan chiacpadomboen naquin Esteban chococaic comapenec sedenquec shubipanëdash.
Adnubien Saudo Esus tantiaquidtedi naimbudte bunquin shubu utsi-utsiec yacnoshon dadabëdtabi chido chedo bedmeshun quënën nauedmepanëdash.
Samadia yacnoshon Esus chuibanaid
Adashic Edusaden yacnoësh nidanec shubu dadpen icquid utsi-utsiec yacno choshon abi tantiaquidon Esus chuibenepanëdash.
Adembidi niante chidobo aton na nibëdsho menequid, Uedipe cuëmëdquid nidaid Samadia caid yacno choshon adembidi Esus chuibanoapanëdash.
Aidën nadatiambocquin nabanquin Esus chuibansho ambocquido iccuededquin bëdamboen tantiapanëdash.
Aidëmbi nadatiambocquin nabanac mayan icsa dapuduedaid icboedi mayan icsa sidquianec cuempanëdash. Adecbidi canite icsaidbëdta caputiapimbocquid dadpen bëdampanëdash.
Adsho isash Samadia yacnocquido, Bëdambo iquebi, quec tabadpanëdash.
Adnubien Samadia yacno ënden chondaid, Nadatiambocquin nabanquid dapa nebi, quequin mayan icsan tantiamiacpaden Simon cuëmëdquidën nabampanëdash.
Adosho isash: “¡Eee! Abimboshenda caposh. Nëid dada Nuquin Papan ambi nadatiambocquin nabante tantiamiaid nec,” quequin anocquidobëdtan abi chuiquidon comapenen tantiapanëdash.
Aden yuen Simonën ismiac, Isnuequid dadpen badiadquidën-badiadquidënquiec abi yacno choash iccuededpanëdash.
Adnubien, Nuquin Papa yacno puduedmianquid Esus nec, quequin Uedipen chuibansho tantiaquid yampanëdash dadabëdi chido chedo. Adsho aidtedi acten mentomepanëdash.
Simontsen: —Esus tantiaquid nebi —quesho acten mentoaqui Simon Uedipebëd capuquimbi Uedipen nadatiambocquin nabansho isun, Adopenshenda nabanec, quequin ispanëdash Simonën.

Adashic yuecash Samadia yacnocquido Edusaden yacno nidash nadpanëdash: —Nuquin Papan chiaid Samadia yacnocquidon tantiabededec. Aden chuisho Esus chuibenequidon tantiashun Uambëdta Petedo Edusaden caid yacnoësh nidaid Samadia caid yacnoshon nidmepanëdash.
Adec aid daëd nidaneshun: —Esus tantiaquid acten mentoaidouidi nëidtedi nec —anocquido quesho tantiashun: —Nëidtedi min Mayan mene, Papa —quec onquequin
Petedobëdtan Uanën mëdanten Esus tantiaquido mamishbampanëdash. Aden mamishbanubi aidtedi Nuquin Papan aton Mayan menepanëdash.
Aden Petedon nasho isash Simon: —Ma adquiec mëquiadnueshun mibi piucquid menenu.
Mimbi matses mamishacpadembi ëmbi mamishaidtedi ma Nuquin Papan Mayan meniaid icpanuna —quepanëdash.
Adoaquien Petedo: —¿Piucquid menecta mibi mëquiadpe? Adoquin mimbi tantianuc tauiantiadpambo chian anëdënquiacno ma mibëdi min piucquid icpanu.
Mimbi Nuquin Papan chiaid icsamboen tantiaquin ëmbi nacpadomboen natiapimbo mibi iquendac.
Mimbi icsamboen tantiaid ënta. Aden icsaid ënsho isash Nuquin Papa mibi icsaid bëpiscudendac.
Mayan icsan yua icquin tactaui tishidaid mishaid mucambo yacpadec icsamboen mimbi muaquin chuibanaido icsaindac.
Adoaquien: —Ëbi tauiantiadpambo chian anëdënquequid nënenushe quiash mibi Uambëd Nuquin Papa chiec bëdamboec onquebudneta —quepanëdash Simon.
Adec Samadia yacno tabadquin Petedobëdtan Uanën: Esus ispondambi, queded-quededquin Nuquin Papan chiaid chuibanashic Edusaden yacno nidquimbi utsi-utsiec yacnoshontsen chuioapanëdash aidëmbidi.
Uedipe Etiopia caid yacnocquidbëd icaid

Adoshombic, Samadia yacno Uedipe icsho Nuquin Papan uaid mayan bëdan nadopanëdash: —Nëuëshquio puduanec nidec Edusaden datambidanec acte dapa yacno shubu dadpen icquid Casa caid yacmi matses nibëdacno podquedën nidash nidtuidtanec chotan.

Adoac nidtoanec nidquimbi Nuquin Papan uaidën mayan bëdan chuibocno choquin Etiopia caid yacnoësh choquid Uedipen bëquedtuidpanëdash. Ancanquid chido Candase cuëmëdquid aton na dayun uashunquid aid dada nepanëdash. Aidi Edusaden yacno nidash tabadquin Nuquin Papa chianec
padpidec Etiopia yacno nidequi aton nidaid cano cabayon nimbanubi antsadtoshon Nuquin Papan chiaid dada uamepampid isec onquequin chuibanec tsadpanëdash.
Adnubien Nuquin Papan Mayanën: —Nidaid cano chinunta —cac
Uedipen titinquequin chinumpanëdash. Aden Etiopia yacnoësh choquid dada uaid isec onquesho isash: —¿Isbanec onquequinda tantiaquie? —quepanëdash Uedipe.
Adoaquien: —Tantiamequid nibëdnuc ¿mitsipadentsimbi tantiape? Ëbëdi antsadtoec cho —cac Uedipe abëdi antsadtopanëdash.
Aidbëdi antsadtoshon Etiopia yacnoësh choquid Nuquin Papan dada uamiampid isec onquesho Uedipen naden tantiapanëdash:

content.text: “Obeca cuesunenuen nimbambocpadomboembidi mëtaneshun nimbanoaposh Nuquin Papan chomiaid unës uanuequin.
Adecbidi obeca bacuë abi datasnuequid icnuc cuëdenquio yacpadec abi unës uanuequid icnuc cuëdenquio icoaposh Nuquin Papan Chomiaid.
Aidi Icsaisa icsho mëyansho isec, Icsambocquidta neque. Isnu, quenquiocposh aton matses.
Aidi chido inesa yec ambi tishmiaid nibëdnuc ¿Tsuntsin ambi naid chuipadic?”

content: Aidtedtsëqui abi isec onqueboed Uedipe ismeshun Etiopia yacnoësh choquidën: —Ëbi isec onqueboed ¿mitsicquid chiequini onquepo? ¿Abibi chiadaidtabi isec onquepo? ¿Utsida chuibaneque? Ëbi chui. Tantianu —capanëdash Etiopia yacnoësh choquidën Uedipe chuiquin.

Adoaquien, Matsestedi icsaid bedshunash abided cuidadec Esus unësaid Nuquin Papa yacno puduedmianquid nec, quequin dada uapampidën chiec, quequin Etiopia yacnoësh choquid tantiamenuen chuibampanëdash Uedipen.
Adoanec nidquimbi Etiopia yacnoësh choquid Esus tantiaquid yanshun actempi istuidshun: —Actempi iqueque. Is. ¿Adabi mentoe? —capanëdash.
Adoaquien Uedipe: —Esus tantiaquidquio nebi, quesho mibi acten mentono —capanëdash. Adoaquien: —Nuquin Papan mado Esuquidistu nec, quequin aid tantiaquid nebi —queshun Etiopia yacnoësh choquidën:
—Nidtuid —cac nidaid cano nidmequidën cabayo nidtuidmian acte budshun Etiopia yacnoësh choquid Uedipen mentopanëdash.
Adashic, acte nantanuësh abi daëdi dectatosho Nuquin Papan Mayanën Uedipe buampanëdash. Adoac Uedipe padpiden isenquio yequi, Esus tantiec bëdambo iquebi, quec Etiopia yacno nidoapanëdash.

Adnubien Uedipe Nuquin Papan Mayanën nidaid utsi Asoto caid yacno buampanëdash. Ambo capucuenequin shubu dadpen icquid yacno-yacnomboen Esus chuibëec onquec choequi shubu dadpen icquid Sesadeya caid yacnotsen choapanëdash.
